## What I checked

Two different things are in play here, and they don't match:

- **The live URL** — `https://example.com/test-page` returns **HTTP 404**. There is no such page.
- **The page content attached to this request** — a description of nav links, a hero, and three feature cards. That's a fixture written for testing the co-browse loop, not content served by that URL.

`example.com` itself is the IANA-reserved placeholder domain, kept specifically so documentation can reference a URL that is guaranteed not to be a real site.[^1][^2]

## Why there's nothing to research

The attached text contains **zero verifiable claims**. It describes layout — "a search box in the top right corner", "three feature cards", "a footer with copyright information". The only substantive strings are the card titles:

| Card title | What it actually asserts |
| --- | --- |
| Instant DuckDB Queries | Nothing measurable — no latency, scale, or benchmark |
| Web Research Automation | Nothing measurable — no sources, method, or coverage |
| Custom Skill Builder | Nothing measurable — no capability boundary or limits |

"Build Smarter with Zo" is marketing copy on a test fixture. There is no number, date, named party, or external referent to verify, so any "research" I produced would be invention — I'd be making up evidence about a page that doesn't exist. That's the one thing I won't do.

## What would actually be useful

Tell me which of these you meant, and I'll run it properly:

- **A real page** — give me the live URL and I'll pull it, extract each claim, and check it against primary sources.
- **The Zo product claims themselves** (DuckDB queries, web research, skill building) — I can research those against Zo's own docs, changelogs, and community reports.
- **Co-browse pipeline validation** — if this was a harness smoke test, the useful output is "fixture rendered, text extraction worked, URL resolution failed." Say the word and I'll write that up as a test note under `Projects/zo-cobrowse/`.

[^1]: https://example.com/
[^2]: https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc2606
